name: Floating LNG (FLNG)
principle: Gas treating, liquefaction, storage and offloading are built on a moored hull over the field. Processes are chosen for compactness and motion tolerance, for example dual mixed refrigerant or expander cycles, and LNG is transferred to carriers side by side or in tandem.

reference_plants.name: Shell Prelude FLNG
reference_plants.capacity: 488 m long; 3.6 Mtpa LNG, 1.3 Mtpa condensate, 0.4 Mtpa LPG; 475 km NNE of Broome
reference_plants.status: first condensate cargo shipped by March 2019

reference_plants.name: PETRONAS PFLNG DUA, Rotan field, Sabah
reference_plants.capacity: 1.5 Mtpa LNG in 1,300 m water depth

reference_plants.name: PETRONAS PFLNG SATU
reference_plants.status: world's first operational FLNG (2016); moved from Kanowit to Kebabangan field in 2019

advantages: Avoids long export pipelines and onshore sites
Can be relocated between fields (PFLNG SATU)
limitations: Marine motion affects columns and transfer
